claims.claim: GENIUS Act signed 18 July 2025; Public Law 119-27
claims.verification: White House signing statement and Congress actions agree. Date is enactment/signing, not later publication or implementation date.

claims.claim: Payment stablecoin statutory subject and issuer redemption obligation
claims.verification: Payment/settlement digital asset with issuer obligation to redeem for fixed amount of monetary value, plus stable-value representation conditions. Story is a concise description, not exhaustive statutory definition.

claims.claim: Federal and qualifying state regulatory paths
claims.verification: Enacted law establishes permitted issuer classes and federal/state supervisory structure. No claim every issuer qualifies.

claims.claim: At least one-to-one reserves, redemption policies, monthly reserve-composition disclosures
claims.verification: Reserve categories include specified eligible liquid assets, not cash-only backing. Uses sets requirements for, not required on signing day.

Section 13 calls for regulations within one year. General effective date is earlier of 18 months after enactment or 120 days after primary federal regulators issue final implementing regulations. Narrative is historical to signing, not a claim about implementation status on research date.

claims.claim: Payment stablecoins not made government-guaranteed money
claims.verification: Law says payment stablecoins not backed by full faith and credit of United States, not guaranteed by US government, not subject to federal deposit/share insurance. Story avoids suggesting guaranteed value or blanket crypto approval.
